faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before getting started.

items.question: Which social networks does Mintly support?
items.answer: Mintly connects with YouTube, TikTok, and Instagram today, with more channels on the way.

items.question: Do I need a credit card to start?
items.answer: No. You can create a free account and start organizing your content right away — no card required.

items.question: Can I invite my team?
items.answer: Yes. You can invite teammates to your organization, assign roles, and collaborate on the same content workspace.

items.question: How does billing work?
items.answer: Mintly uses usage-based billing — you only pay for what your organization actually processes and publishes.

items.question: Can I cancel anytime?
items.answer: Yes, you can cancel your plan at any time from your organization settings, no questions asked.
